note: STRICT-004 use stable logical paths, recorded in the declared Linux environment. The action's view is the logical tree: the chroot root is /jckg and the action's paths begin with /jckg, so the physical layout repeats the prefix and the action's cwd is exactly /jckg/workspace whatever the host workspace is. The test runs the same check twice against two different host workspaces and requires the observed path to be identical both times - which is what makes two builds comparable - and requires the host path to be absent. Fault proof: pointing the action's cwd at / makes the logical-paths assertion fail (exit 1); revert restored the exact line, no FAULT markers remain.
